name: thermal-pause
scope: Pinned factory thermal_pause (WALT PAUSE_THERMAL cooling devices); native 7.3 lifetime and lock-order port
reviewed_changes: Keep OF cdev per available child (alias or thermal-pause-<mask>), max level 1, register only when the whole group is online, exported notifier/paused-mask API and resume-ownership rule
Per-device context on a global list instead of a global list re-initialised by every probe; single-instance cpuhp state shared by refcount

Teardown cancels registration work, unregisters cdevs without holding the lock set_cur_state takes, cancels pending updates, then resumes synchronously (factory queued a resume work and freed its memory)
Child OF node references held for the cdev lifetime; 7.3 thermal_of_cooling_device_register(np, id, ...) signature
pending: Phone thermal HAL use of pause-cpuN/thermal-pause types and power effect of halting
